name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.login.view.LoginActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this page when a user signs in. It checks the account and password, then handles the login result and any required identity-verification prompt.
